title: Maximum affine spaces of bent APN components
summary: Determine the largest dimension of an affine space of bent components of an APN vectorial function in every even dimension.

formal_statement.body: For every positive even integer $n$, determine the maximum dimension of an affine space consisting entirely of bent scalar components of an APN function $F:\mathbb F_2^n\to\mathbb F_2^n$. Give matching upper bounds and constructions.

scope.domain: APN vectorial functions and affine spaces of bent components
scope.unresolved_remainder: For plateaued APN functions, the later linear-structure theorem rules out the maximum possible dimension n-1, but the exact plateaued maximum remains unknown. The exact maximum over all APN functions is still open for every even n.

citations.locator: Proposition 7.2, combined with the source hyperplane equivalence

progress.summary: The TIT source explicitly states this unresolved problem and fixes its mathematical scope.

progress.summary: Proposition 7.2 excludes nontrivial linear structures for even-dimensional plateaued APN functions; through the source equivalence, this rules out an affine hyperplane of bent components in that strict subclass.
